coverage: Read native schematic, PCB, requirements and check records. Independently exported connectivity matches work/netlist/connectivity.json.
Repeated saved-board DRC with schematic parity: zero violations, unconnected items or parity issues; see review-work/physical/experiments/independent_drc.json.
Inspected placement, closed outline, OUT junction and C1 ground return through the via, saved back copper and J1.3 thermal spokes; see review-work/physical/experiments/physical_inspection.json.
Calculated nominal unloaded response and checked it with ngspice: 0.632121 V at 1 ms. Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/review_log.md.

findings.condition: The required measurement includes a switched ADC whose sampling capacitance, switch resistance, prior charge and sampling timing are unspecified.

evidence.locator: line 1: required voltage band and unspecified ADC parameters
C1 value at line 955; R1 value at line 1274
J1.2 OUT pad at line 596; OUT routing at lines 675–698

findings.mechanism: ADC sampling exchanges charge with C1 through the output connection. The resulting disturbance and recovery depend on the missing ADC parameters and switching history.
findings.reasoning: With ideal nominal 10 kΩ and 100 nF components, an initially discharged capacitor and no load, VOUT(1 ms)=1−exp(−1)=0.632121 V, within the specified band. This baseline and the passing native checks do not establish the ADC-connected response. No actual band violation or saved-board connectivity defect was demonstrated.
findings.title: ADC-connected response remains unverified

limitations: No ADC-connected simulation or measurement was possible without defining the missing load and timing parameters.
No component tolerance, leakage, bias, temperature or selected-part model was evaluated; source impedance, actual rise time and initial filter charge remain unspecified.
No extracted PCB, connector, cable or return-path impedance model or manufactured-board measurement was evaluated.
Zone connectivity was examined as saved; no refill or fabrication-export validation was performed. Geometry sampling supplements native DRC but is not a continuous-path proof.
No fabrication capability, part-specific assembly, ampacity or thermal qualification was established. Track width alone was not used to infer qualification.
Original ERC was reviewed but not rerun. Ignored checks remain documented in work/erc/erc.json and work/drc/drc.json.
